data.name: Uncanny Smile | The Last Harvest
data.detailed_description:
Uncanny Smile | The Last Harvest

The first episode of Uncanny Smile you play as a visitor to a strange world. You don't know how you got their and you must learn to live in this strange world as a farmer. Who can you trust? Are you safe? What dangerous are lurking in this world?

The Gameplay: 

The game is a first person narrative farming simulator with exploration, conversation and story mechanics. You must farm, sell your crops, upgrade your tools and sacrifice your remaining crops to the Pumpking each day. As the days progress more and more dangerous are released into this world, you have to balance meeting the demands of the Pumpking with your own survival. 

Key Features:

  • Atmospheric environment and a stylised art style.

  • Fun Simple Farming Mechanics such as growing, picking and, selling your crops to buy more tools to farm faster and, to a larger scale. 

  • Unique NPCs.

  • Piece together the narrative of this world, it's purpose, why you arrived here, who you can trust.

data.short_description: Arriving in a strange world, your only way to return home is to farm for the Pumpking in return for a safe passage. You must grow your farm, survive the dangerous of this world and make it home. Be careful who you trust.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
